q: Which description of Microsoft 365 tenant is accurate?
choices: Entra policy that can block a phone or a room that is not in the trusted device set.
A coexistence mode. Direct Routing is not supported for users in Islands mode.
Voice-focused administration of calling and phone numbers. Check the current role article before you grant Global Administrator out of habit.
The boundary that holds Entra ID, licenses, Teams policies, and verified domains for one organization.

A shared handset. On Direct Routing it does not need a Calling Plan license.

A balance used when a call is not covered by a Calling Plan minute. Voice apps use it for some outbound cases.
explain: A Calling Plan billed on use. Also the funding pattern, with communications credits, for some voice-app outbound calls. External transfers from a queue are not free just because users have Direct Routing. q: Which description of Operator Connect is accurate?

Moving a public number from one carrier to another. It has a date and a letter of authority. It is not a PowerShell metaphor.

q: Which description of Voice routing policy is accurate?
choices: The per-user list of PSTN usages, in order. Teams walks that order when it looks for a route.
A name that links a voice routing policy to one or more voice routes. The policy’s ordered list of usages is the permission to place those calls.
Each voice route lists SBCs with a priority. Lower priority number is tried first in this campus’s teaching model. Confirm the current article before you depend on a tie.
A short rule can turn a 4-digit extension into E.164. It must not run before emergency codes.
explain: The per-user list of PSTN usages, in order. Teams walks that order when it looks for a route. Granting the wrong policy is the most common ‘the SBC is broken’ ticket. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/manage-voice-routing-policies accessed 2026-10-14.

q: Which description of Direct Routing emergency is accurate?
choices: Civic addresses are validated. An unvalidated string is not a location you can trust.
An emergency calling policy can notify people on site when an emergency call is placed.
You, the SBC, and the carrier deliver the emergency call. Microsoft does not become the emergency carrier because Teams is the client.
The SBA still needs a PSTN path. That is the local SBC and carrier, not a cloud media processor you cannot reach.
explain: You, the SBC, and the carrier deliver the emergency call. Microsoft does not become the emergency carrier because Teams is the client. PIDF-LO may be present. The carrier still has to accept the call. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/what-are-emergency-locations-addresses-and-call-routing accessed 2026-10-14.

q: Which description of Call Analytics is accurate?
choices: A commonly taught CQD clue is to treat sustained jitter around 30 ms as painful. Confirm the current data dictionary before you quote a threshold as policy.
The per-user, per-call quality view in the Teams admin center. Use it when one person had one bad call.
The client waits a little so late packets can still be played. Too small and you hear gaps. Too large and you talk over each other.
Who the request claims to be, and who it is for. A normalization bug shows up here as a duplicated country code.
explain: The per-user, per-call quality view in the Teams admin center. Use it when one person had one bad call. It will not explain a building. That is CQD. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/use-call-analytics-to-troubleshoot-poor-call-quality accessed 2026-10-14.

q: Which description of Connect model is accurate?

A certified contact center attaches to Teams through certified SBCs and Direct Routing.
During coexistence, either Teams or CUCM should transform numbers, not both.
Microsoft Graph APIs used by Extend and by recording and presence integrations. They are not a SIP trunk.

Microsoft’s note: the contact-center agent does not need a phone-system license for that solution; a Teams user who receives a transfer does. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-contact-center accessed 2026-10-14.

q: Which description of Recognize step is accurate?
choices: The ACS server-side calling API. Your app answers, plays, recognizes DTMF or speech, and transfers. You receive events. You do not drive a desktop click.
The Call Automation action that collects DTMF or speech. It needs a timeout and a path for ‘none of the above.’
The classic-topic path when nothing else matches. Empty fallback is silence.
The menu-like Copilot Studio design. Predictable and easier to test. Weaker on paraphrase.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/communication-services/concepts/call-automation/call-automation accessed 2026-10-14.

q: Which description of Call-ID is accurate?
choices: The table that says which subnet is which building in CQD. It is only as good as the subnets you typed.
A 15-minute or 30-minute bucket of offered, answered, and abandoned contacts. WFM and Erlang C both assume you know the bucket.
A user starts a recording of a call, meeting, or event. Policy can allow it. The user can stop it. Storage follows meeting rules.
The SIP header that identifies one dialog. It is the join key between an SBC capture, a carrier ticket, and a CRM note.
